context_requirements: Expression of SLC12A5 (KCC2) is essentially restricted to neurons; none of the nine lines are neuronal
An intact Cl- gradient and neuronal KCC2-dependent inhibitory signalling, absent in these lines
No transcriptional readout is expected from ion transport inhibition alone in non-neuronal cells
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across lines that matches a known off-target class (e.g. general stress, apoptosis, cholesterol synthesis)
Evidence of SLC12A5 expression in these lines with a corresponding dose-dependent response
